newsitem.title: USA: Union Pacific slams Pennzoil rejection. [CORRECTED 22:52 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Union Pacific slams Pennzoil rejection. [CORRECTED 22:52 GMT]

text.p: Union Pacific Resources Group Inc said Pennzoil Co's refusal to respond positively to its hostile bid after UPR received acceptances from 61.5 percent of the target's shareholders was irresponsible.
Pennzoil earlier said it continued to reject the hostile $4.0 billion offer because the cash and stock deal was of uncertain value and divisive.
The tenders were in response to a cash offer for 50.1 percent of Pennzoil stock, which Union Pacific plans to follow with an offer of its own stock for the remaining 49.9 percent of Pennzoil.
"Pennzoil's attempt to explain away this result will convince no one," said UPR's chief executive Jack Messman.

He said the fact 61.5 percent (corrects from 65.1 percent) of Pennzoil shareholders tendered their shares meant they had "asked Pennzoil's board to take the necessary steps to allow UPR to complete the transaction".
